result.history: 23 tests passed at the first delivery; two more were added for the per-run optimizer-ledger collision found during T13-07 (25 total)

legacySuiteResult.note: the pre-existing V11 trainer regressions still pass after the T13-01 changes

tests.name: test_value_mask_uses_one_index_set
tests.proves: targets [1,-1] with mask [true,false] produces loss 1.0625 / gradient +0.5 under the old filters and 0.5625 / -1.5 under the shipped fix, on real torch

tests.name: test_two_predictions_three_targets_raises
tests.proves: the old shape mismatch is an error, never a silent broadcast

tests.name: test_trainer_refuses_explicit_mask_that_contradicts_target
tests.proves: a dataset whose explicit valueLossMask disagrees with valueTarget is rejected at load time

tests.name: test_mixed_mask_batch_trains_without_shape_error
tests.proves: the normal mixed case still trains

tests.name: test_train_loss_is_single_counted_and_matches_legacy_halving
tests.proves: legacy accounting inflates train_loss relative to the shipped fix while optimizer updates and exposures are identical

tests.name: test_legacy_inflation_is_not_a_clean_factor_when_the_cap_cuts_an_epoch
tests.proves: the pre-V13 mean is not the mean of anything when a cap break sits between the two accumulation sites

tests.name: test_fixed_train_loss_is_comparable_to_val_loss
tests.proves: train and val loss are now the same kind of number instead of a fake 2x overfitting gap

tests.name: test_val_loss_is_unchanged_by_the_accounting_fix
tests.proves: validation never entered the optimizer block, so it was already correct

tests.name: test_capped_run_does_not_drop_the_last_optimized_batch
tests.proves: a global cap fires after the batch is counted, not before

tests.name: test_global_cap_holds_across_epoch_boundary
tests.proves: the cap is measured across epochs via the consumption ledger

tests.name: test_all_masks_false_is_not_counted_as_learning
tests.proves: an all-masked run reports zero supervised value exposures and zero policy accuracy

tests.name: test_missing_split_manifest_fails_closed
tests.proves: a named-but-absent split manifest aborts instead of substituting an internal split

tests.name: test_missing_init_checkpoint_fails_closed
tests.proves: a named-but-absent init checkpoint aborts instead of training from scratch

tests.name: test_rows_without_root_identity_are_refused_by_default
tests.proves: the ep_{idx//60} grouping key is opt-in

tests.name: test_legacy_grouping_is_watermarked_when_explicitly_enabled
tests.proves: when explicitly enabled the run carries a LEGACY_GROUPING watermark and the row count

tests.name: test_overlapping_split_root_families_are_refused
tests.proves: train/val/test root overlap is rejected

tests.name: test_unknown_root_family_in_split_is_refused
tests.proves: a manifest that omits a present root aborts rather than defaulting it into train

tests.name: test_duplicate_sample_id_with_conflicting_state_hash_is_refused
tests.proves: ambiguous sample identity is rejected

tests.name: test_model_seed_changes_weights_but_not_the_split
tests.proves: with a frozen manifest the partition is identical and only the weights differ

tests.name: test_split_seed_does_not_leak_into_model_init
tests.proves: changing --split-seed under a frozen manifest produces byte-identical weights

tests.name: test_non_finite_value_target_is_refused
tests.proves: NaN labels are refused at load time

tests.name: test_planned_manifest_is_not_consumption_evidence
tests.proves: the pre-training file is labelled measured=false / isConsumptionEvidence=false

tests.name: test_state_file_is_written_and_resumes
tests.proves: the resumable state is a separate artifact and resume continues at the right epoch

tests.name: test_two_runs_in_one_directory_keep_separate_ledgers
tests.proves: two runs sharing an output directory each keep their own consumption ledger
tests.foundBy: T13-07 lost two of three ledgers to this collision in its first pass

tests.name: test_reusing_an_out_model_refuses_to_clobber_the_ledger
tests.proves: a second run against the same --out-model aborts instead of overwriting consumption evidence

notClaimed: This task does not claim any playing-strength improvement. It changes reporting, validation and provenance only; the optimizer step count and the weights it produces are unchanged by the accounting fix.
